decision.statement: Ibn Kathir states that the attribution of this interpretation to Ali does not hold.
decision.rationale: The catalog definition distinguishes editorial commentary from transmitted content; Ibn Kathir's la yasihh is his own source-critical comment. This is an assistant classification decision, not independent authentication or human approval.
decision.scope: Only immediately preceding Ali attribution; no automatic extension to al-Shabi.
